# Pane

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:pane` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

An unpadded application column with optional vertical header/footer slots, one scrolling vertical content stack, and independent logical-edge separators.

## When to use

Organize a sidebar, main area, inspector, or dialog column into fixed vertical header/footer chrome around one scrolling content owner.

- An application column needs shared header, content, and optional footer organization with exactly one scrolling content owner.
- A pane boundary needs an opt-in separator on any combination of logical sides.

**Not when:**

- Do not use Pane as a padded card or add a competing scroll owner around its content slot.
- Do not enable separators merely as decoration; use them only where the pane owns a real boundary.

**Alternatives:**

- [Application layout](./layout.md) (composes-with) — Use the layout content-item and control classes inside Pane when children need shared geometry.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/pane` — exports `Pane`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/pane` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/pane.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/pane`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuipane) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- content only
- header + content
- header + content + footer
- block-start separator
- block-end separator
- inline-start separator
- inline-end separator

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-column`, `sidebar`, `main-content`, `inspector`, `dialog-column`.
- Children: unrestricted.

Zones (a zone is bound to JSX only through its listed prop; never assume the zone id is a prop):

- `header` — JSX prop `header`; accepts `fixed-chrome`; any number.
- `content` — JSX prop `children`; accepts `pane-content`; any number.
- `footer` — JSX prop `footer`; accepts `fixed-chrome`; any number.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** root and content semantics; accessible labels; header, content, and footer children; which logical boundaries show separators; which sides may compensate for device safe areas in an app-owned arrangement (safeAreaEdges); responsive placement and visibility.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: child · border: conditional · padding: child (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- The pane is unpadded; separators are independently opt-in on logical edges and default off.
- Safe areas: the root and separators paint through unsafe areas while header, content, and footer pad the sides the pane still reaches (routed by --kui-edge-inset-\*); content block insets are scroll padding.

## Accessibility

- Choose semantic root and content elements that match the region and provide labels for landmark elements.
- Keep fixed header/footer chrome outside the single scrolling content slot so reading and focus order remain coherent.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-pane`, `kui-pane__content`, `kui-pane__footer`, `kui-pane__header`, `kui-pane__toolbar`.

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-edge-inset-block-end`, `--kui-edge-inset-block-start`, `--kui-edge-inset-inline-end`, `--kui-edge-inset-inline-start`, `--kui-pane-separator-color`, `--kui-pane-separator-width`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and forced component dimensions (`KUI-L005`).
